title: Viscous vortex domains: 2-D Navier-Stokes without a mesh
description: The mesh-free Lagrangian vorticity solver: the panel integrals against a 20000-point quadrature, the potential flow past a cylinder against Cp = 1 - 4 sin^2(theta), the attached sheet of a spinning cylinder against its surface speed, the diffusion drift against 2 nu r / sigma^2, a cylinder at Re = 40 against Dennis & Chang (1970), and a NACA 0012 at zero incidence with a spoiler that deploys to 90 degrees at Re = 4e4.

metrics.name: panel_influence_relative_error
metrics.how: closed-form source and vortex panels against a 20000-point quadrature of the point kernels (verification.check_panel_influence)

metrics.name: potential_flow_cp_error
metrics.how: largest |Cp - (1 - 4 sin^2 theta)| on an 80-panel cylinder in a uniform stream (verification.check_potential_flow)

metrics.name: spinning_cylinder_sheet_error
metrics.how: relative error of the uniform attached sheet of a 64-panel cylinder spinning at 1 rad/s against its surface speed 0.5 (verification.check_spinning_cylinder)

metrics.name: diffusion_drift_relative_error
metrics.how: radial drift of a Gaussian patch at r = sigma against 2 nu / sigma (verification.check_diffusion)

metrics.name: cylinder_cd_re40
metrics.how: 32 panels, t_end = 0.6, mean over the last third (cylinder_verification.py); 0.55 at 96 panels and t = 1.9. Dennis & Chang 1970 give 1.3375, so the drag is 37 % low at 32 panels and 59 % low at 96: no slip is not enforced at the wall

metrics.name: cylinder_cl_re40
metrics.how: the same run: a symmetric body at zero incidence must have no lift, and it has none

metrics.name: spoiler_cl_flush
metrics.how: NACA 0012 at zero incidence with the spoiler flush, 180 section panels and 24 spoiler panels, t = 0.4 (naca0012_spoiler.py); a symmetric section owes an observer zero lift

metrics.name: spoiler_cd_flush
metrics.how: the same run, wall pressure plus wall shear over the panels, normalised on 0.5 rho U^2 c

notes: The panel machinery and the potential flow are exact; the cylinder drag is not (no no-slip condition at the wall) and the spoiler's deployment is the case the current wall model does not survive -- the guide says why. The flush state before the deployment is reproducible and physical.
